msgs.text: Hey! Are you still coming to the study group tonight?
Yes, but I'll be 15 min late. My shift at the café ends at 6.
No problem. We're in Room 204 this time, not the library.
Got it. Should I bring anything?
Just your notes from Tuesday's lecture.

qs.stem: Why will Leo be late?
opts: He missed the bus.
The library is closed.
He forgot his notes.
He has to finish work first.
qs.ex: Лео пишет: «My shift at the café ends at 6» — у него смена в кафе. Про автобус и закрытую библиотеку в переписке ничего нет, а заметки он только спрашивает, нужно ли брать.

qs.stem: Where will the study group meet?
opts: In the library
At the café
In the lecture hall
In Room 204
qs.ex: «We're in Room 204 this time, not the library». Ловушка — библиотека: она упомянута, но с отрицанием not.

doc.head: Lost & Found — Student Center
paras: Found on Monday: a blue water bottle with stickers, a black umbrella, and a set of keys on a red keychain.
Items can be picked up at the front desk, 9 a.m.–5 p.m., Monday to Friday. Please bring your student ID.
Items not claimed within 30 days will be donated.

qs.stem: What is the main purpose of the notice?
opts: To sell items that nobody wanted
To ask students to donate old items
To announce new opening hours for the Student Center
To tell students where they can collect lost items
qs.ex: Главная цель — сообщить, что найдены вещи и где их забрать. Про пожертвование сказано только как о последствии через 30 дней, это деталь, а не цель.

qs.stem: What must students bring to pick up an item?
opts: A receipt
A photo of the item
A note from a teacher
Their student ID
qs.ex: «Please bring your student ID» — прямо сказано в объявлении.

doc.head: Campus Gym — Fall Hours
rows: 7:00 a.m. – 10:00 p.m. (pool closed 12–2 p.m. for swim classes)
doc.foot: Towels are no longer provided. Please bring your own.

qs.stem: A student wants to swim at 1:00 p.m. On which day can she do this?
opts: Tuesday
Sunday
Thursday
Wednesday
qs.ex: Во вторник и четверг бассейн закрыт с 12 до 2 — значит, в 13:00 плавать нельзя. В воскресенье спортзал закрыт целиком. Остаётся среда.

qs.stem: What is suggested about towels?
opts: Towels are only needed in the pool.
Towels can be rented at the front desk.
Students must wash the gym's towels.
The gym used to give towels to students.
qs.ex: «No longer provided» — «больше не выдаются». Значит, раньше их выдавали. Это вывод из слов no longer, прямо об этом не сказано.

doc.subject: Water shut-off on Thursday
paras: Dear residents,

Plumbers will replace the main water pipe in Oak Hall on Thursday, March 12. Water will be shut off from 9 a.m. to approximately 3 p.m. Showers and sinks on all floors will be unavailable during this time.
Bottled water will be available in the lobby. Residents who need to shower may use the facilities in Pine Hall, which will not be affected.
We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience.
Housing Office

qs.stem: What is the main purpose of the email?
opts: To ask residents to report a broken pipe
To invite residents to move to Pine Hall
To announce that Oak Hall will close
To inform residents about a temporary loss of water
qs.ex: Письмо сообщает, что в четверг на несколько часов отключат воду. Переезжать в Pine Hall никто не предлагает — туда можно сходить в душ.

qs.stem: According to the email, what can residents do if they need to take a shower?
opts: Use the showers in Pine Hall
Wait until the evening
Ask the plumbers for permission
Use bottled water from the lobby
qs.ex: «Residents who need to shower may use the facilities in Pine Hall». Бутилированная вода в лобби — для питья, не для душа.

qs.stem: The word "affected" in the email is closest in meaning to
opts: repaired
closed
inspected
influenced
qs.ex: Pine Hall «will not be affected» — работы на него не повлияют. Affected = influenced. «Repaired» — частая ловушка: ремонт упоминается в письме, но это не синоним.

paras: Swap, don't shop! Our clothing swap is back on Saturday, 11 a.m.–3 p.m., in the Student Center ballroom.
Bring up to 5 clean items you no longer wear and leave with the same number of "new" ones. Leftover clothes will go to a local shelter.
Volunteers needed for setup at 10 — DM us if you can help!

qs.stem: What is the post mainly about?
opts: A sale of new clothes on campus
A new club for students who like fashion
A request for donations to a shelter
An event where students exchange clothing
qs.ex: Swap = обмен: приносишь вещи и уносишь столько же других. Приют упоминается только как место, куда отдадут остатки.

qs.stem: What will happen to clothes that nobody takes?
opts: They will be sold.
They will be returned to their owners.
They will be kept for the next swap.
They will be given to a shelter.
qs.ex: «Leftover clothes will go to a local shelter». Leftover = оставшиеся.

qs.stem: What does "DM us" mean in the post?
opts: Send us a private message
Come to our office
Donate money to us
Call our manager
qs.ex: DM — direct message, личное сообщение в соцсети. В Daily Life ETS проверяет неформальный и сокращённый язык.

doc.head: Campus Bookstore
doc.foot: Paid by card. Returns accepted within 14 days with receipt. Used textbooks may be returned only if unmarked.

qs.stem: How much did the items cost before the discount?
qs.ex: До скидки — Subtotal, $54.75. $49.27 — итог после скидки, $5.48 — сама скидка.

qs.stem: Why might the customer be unable to return the psychology book?
opts: Because it was bought with a card
Because it was on sale
Because returns are never accepted
Because the customer writes in it
qs.ex: Подержанные учебники принимают «only if unmarked» — только без пометок. Если покупатель что-то в нём напишет, вернуть не получится. Это вывод из условия.

qs.stem: What is true about the purchase?
opts: The discount applied only to the textbook.
The customer paid in cash.
A discount was taken off the whole subtotal.
The highlighters were free.
qs.ex: 10% от $54.75 = $5.48 — значит, скидка посчитана от всей суммы, а не от одного учебника. Оплата — картой (Paid by card).

doc.subject: Change to final project requirements
paras: Dear all,

After reviewing your proposals, I've decided to adjust the final project. Rather than submitting a 15-page individual paper, you'll work in pairs and produce a 10-page report plus a 10-minute presentation in our last session.
I realize some of you have already begun drafting, so if you strongly prefer to continue individually, email me by Friday with a brief justification — I'll approve reasonable requests.
The deadline remains unchanged.

Best,
Dr. Moreno

qs.stem: What is the main purpose of the email?
opts: To explain a new format for the final project
To cancel the final presentation
To ask students to submit proposals
To announce a later deadline
qs.ex: Профессор меняет формат: работа в парах, отчёт на 10 страниц и презентация. Дедлайн, наоборот, не меняется.

qs.stem: All of the following are true according to the email EXCEPT:
opts: Students will give a presentation.
The report will be shorter than the original paper.
The deadline has been extended.
Some students have started writing already.
qs.ex: «The deadline remains unchanged» — срок не продлили. Остальные три утверждения в письме есть.

qs.stem: What can be inferred about students who have already started writing?
opts: They must start a new project.
They will receive extra credit.
They may be allowed to keep working alone.
They have to present first.
qs.ex: Можно написать до пятницы с объяснением — разумные просьбы одобрят. Значит, им, скорее всего, разрешат работать в одиночку. Прямо это не обещано — отсюда «may».

msgs.text: Did anyone else get charged twice for the lab fee?
Same here. Called the bursar — apparently it's a system glitch, refunds go out automatically within 5 business days.
Ugh, I need that money for rent before then.
You can request an emergency advance at the financial aid office. Took me like 10 min last semester.
Lifesaver, thanks!

qs.stem: What problem are the students discussing?
opts: They cannot find the lab.
The financial aid office is closed.
Their rent has increased.
They paid the lab fee two times.
qs.ex: «Charged twice for the lab fee» — с них дважды списали плату за лабораторию.

qs.stem: Why is Priya worried?
opts: She may not get her refund in time to pay rent.
She does not know where the bursar's office is.
She thinks the refund will never come.
She has to pay for the lab again.
qs.ex: Возврат придёт в течение 5 рабочих дней, а деньги нужны на аренду «before then» — раньше. Она не сомневается в возврате, её беспокоит срок.

qs.stem: What does Priya mean when she writes "Lifesaver"?
opts: Ana's idea is very helpful.
Ana should be more careful.
The situation is dangerous.
She will call for help.
qs.ex: Lifesaver в разговорной речи — «ты меня спас(ла)», то есть совет очень помог. Буквальное значение («спасатель») здесь не подходит.

doc.head: Library Quiet Floors — Updated Policy
paras: Floors 3 and 4 are designated quiet zones. Brief, whispered conversations are acceptable on Floor 3; Floor 4 is silent at all times. Phone calls must be taken in the stairwells.
Group study rooms on Floor 2 can be reserved online up to 7 days in advance, for a maximum of 3 hours per day per group.
Reservations not claimed within 15 minutes will be released to waiting students.

qs.stem: Where should students take phone calls?
opts: On Floor 3
In the group study rooms
In the stairwells
On Floor 4
qs.ex: «Phone calls must be taken in the stairwells» — только на лестнице.

qs.stem: What will most likely happen if a group arrives 20 minutes late for its reserved room?
opts: The group will have to pay a fee.
The room may be given to other students.
The group will get an extra hour.
The library will cancel all of the group's future reservations.
qs.ex: Бронь, которую не заняли в течение 15 минут, «будет передана ожидающим студентам». 20 минут — больше 15, значит, комнату, скорее всего, отдадут.

qs.stem: According to the policy, which of the following is NOT allowed?
opts: Whispering on Floor 3
Reserving a room 5 days ahead
Whispering on Floor 4
Using a study room for 2 hours
qs.ex: На 4-м этаже «silent at all times» — даже шёпот нельзя. Шёпот разрешён только на 3-м. Бронь за 5 дней и на 2 часа укладывается в правила.

doc.head: Birch Apartments · Parcel shelf moved
paras: From Monday, small parcels will be kept beside the laundry room instead of at the main desk. The shelf is open from 7 a.m. to 9 p.m. Find your parcel using the flat number on its label. Large boxes will still be held by the building manager. Please take only items addressed to you. If a parcel is missing, leave a message for the manager with the delivery date.
Collect parcels soon after delivery to avoid crowding. Check inside the label pocket if the flat number is hard to read.

qs.stem: What is the notice mainly about?
opts: A new delivery company
A limit on the number of parcels
A change to laundry prices
A new place to collect small parcels
qs.ex: Главная мысль — в заголовке «Parcel shelf moved» и первой фразе: маленькие посылки теперь лежат у прачечной, а не на стойке. Laundry упоминается только как место, про цены ничего нет.

qs.stem: Where should residents collect a large box?
opts: From the building manager
From the delivery driver's office
From the laundry machines
From the new parcel shelf
qs.ex: «Large boxes will still be held by the building manager». Полка — только для маленьких посылок, это ловушка.

doc.subject: This week's practice
paras: Hi everyone,

Our practice this Friday will be in the school dining room because the music room is being painted. We will start at 6 p.m., as usual. Enter through the side door next to the car park. Bring the song sheets from last week. I will bring extra copies for anyone who has lost theirs. There is no practice next Friday because the school will be closed.
We will practice the opening song first, then work on the new ending. You can leave coats on the chairs near the door.
Naomi

qs.stem: Why will the choir use the dining room?
opts: The music room is being painted
The song sheets are stored there
More singers have joined
The school is closed this Friday
qs.ex: «…in the school dining room because the music room is being painted». Школа закрыта не в эту, а в следующую пятницу — ловушка.

qs.stem: What should a singer do if they have lost their song sheets?
opts: Wait until next Friday
Get copies from Naomi
Collect them from the music room
Print them at the car park
qs.ex: «I will bring extra copies for anyone who has lost theirs» — копии принесёт Наоми.

doc.head: Corner Plate - Morning Menu · Served 7-11 a.m., Monday to Friday
doc.foot: Order and pay at the counter. We will bring your food to your table. Food can also be packed to take away. Please tell us when ordering. The tea offer applies to both eat-in and takeaway orders. Milk is available with tea or coffee at no extra charge. Please ask about ingredients if you have a food allergy. High chairs for young children are beside the window.

qs.stem: How much is an egg sandwich with tea under the offer?
qs.ex: Сэндвич стоит $5, по акции к цене еды добавляется $1: 5 + 1 = $6. Вариант $7 — это 5 + 2, обычная цена чая без акции.

qs.stem: What should customers do if they want food to take away?
opts: Buy coffee with their food
Tell staff when ordering
Collect food from a table
Order after 11 a.m.
qs.ex: «Food can also be packed to take away. Please tell us when ordering» — нужно сказать при заказе.

msgs.text: 10 p.m.: Can you pick me up for the match tomorrow? My bike has a flat tire.
13 p.m.: Sure. I'm leaving home at 9:20. I can reach your house at 9:30.
15 p.m.: Thanks! I'll wait outside. Should I bring water for both of us?
17 p.m.: Just for yourself. I have mine. Bring the tickets, though. You bought them.
18 p.m.: They're already in my bag.
20 p.m.: The weather looks sunny, so bring a hat too. We can get lunch near the ground after the match.

qs.stem: When will Priya reach Ellis's house?
qs.ex: «I can reach your house at 9:30». 9:20 — время, когда Прия выезжает из дома, а 4:10 и 4:18 — время сообщений.

qs.stem: Who is responsible for bringing the tickets?
opts: Both friends separately
Ellis
Priya
Someone at the match
qs.ex: Прия пишет: «Bring the tickets, though. You bought them» — билеты у Эллиса, он и должен их взять.

doc.head: Have your pet photographed at Willow Garden this Sunday!
paras: Our photographer will be beside the main gate from 1 to 4 p.m. A ten-minute photo session costs $15 and includes two digital pictures sent by email. Dogs must be on a lead. Cats and other small pets should arrive in a carrier. Book a time by calling the garden office. You do not need to pay the usual garden entrance fee if you come only for the photos.
There is a shaded waiting area for pets and owners. Please arrive five minutes before your session and have a favorite toy ready to help your pet look toward the camera.

qs.stem: What is included in the $15 price?
opts: A pet carrier
A printed photo album
A full-day garden tour
Two digital pictures
qs.ex: «…costs $15 and includes two digital pictures sent by email». Альбома, переноски и экскурсии в цену не входит.

qs.stem: How can people book a session?
opts: Wait at the gate on Monday
Buy a garden tour ticket
Call the garden office
Email the photographer their pictures
qs.ex: «Book a time by calling the garden office». Фото отправляют по email, но бронирование — по телефону.

doc.head: Brook Radio - Open Afternoon · Saturday, June 8
doc.foot:
Places are free, but visitors must register on our website. Children under twelve must come with an adult. Arrive ten minutes before the welcome so we can check your name. Please keep phones silent inside the recording rooms.
The tour includes a short explanation of how sound is recorded. Please leave food and drinks outside the studio rooms.

qs.stem: Which activity begins at 2:30?
opts: Meeting a news presenter
Touring the recording rooms
Checking in at reception
Reading a weather report
qs.ex: В расписании: «2:30: Try reading a weather report». Встреча с ведущим — в 2:00.

qs.stem: What must all visitors do before attending?
opts: Bring a child with them
Pay for a place
Prepare a news story
Register online
qs.ex: «Places are free, but visitors must register on our website». Взрослый нужен только детям до 12 лет, а платить не надо.

doc.head: Oak House Shared Kitchen
paras: Please write your name and the date on food you leave in the fridge. Blank labels are in the drawer under the kettle. Every Wednesday morning, the cleaner removes food that has no name on it. Food with a name will stay, unless it is clearly spoiled. Use the cupboard for bread and unopened tins. The fridge's top shelf is for milk only, so there is room for everyone's bottles.
Close food containers tightly and wipe up any spills before leaving the kitchen. Do not move another resident's food without asking. Tell the house team if you notice the fridge leaking.

qs.stem: Where can residents find blank labels?
opts: Inside the bread cupboard
On the fridge's top shelf
In the drawer under the kettle
Beside the cleaner's trolley
qs.ex: «Blank labels are in the drawer under the kettle».

qs.stem: Which food will the cleaner remove on Wednesday?
opts: All food labeled on Tuesday
All food on the top shelf
Food with no name on it
All unopened tins
qs.ex: «The cleaner removes food that has no name on it». Подписанная еда остаётся, если не испортилась.

doc.subject: Your jacket is ready
paras: Hello Owen,

We have finished shortening your jacket sleeves. You can collect the jacket any day this week between 10 a.m. and 5 p.m. We are closed on Sunday. Please bring your collection slip so we can find the correct item quickly. The remaining payment is $18. You paid the other $12 when you left the jacket with us. We accept cash and cards.
You may try the jacket on in the shop before taking it home. Please check that both sleeves feel comfortable when you bend your arms.
Thank you,
Harbor Alterations

qs.stem: How much does Owen still need to pay?
qs.ex: «The remaining payment is $18. You paid the other $12» — осталось $18. $30 — полная цена, $12 — уже оплачено.

qs.stem: Why is Owen asked to bring his collection slip?
opts: To change the shop's opening hours
To apply for a refund
To get the sleeves measured
To help staff find his jacket
qs.ex: «Please bring your collection slip so we can find the correct item quickly» — чтобы быстро найти его вещь.

paras: Want to draw with other people? Our small group meets at the riverside café every Thursday at 7 p.m. We choose a simple object to draw and share ideas. You don't need any experience. Bring a pencil and some paper; there is no class fee. Please buy a drink because the café lets us use its tables. Send me a message before your first visit so I can save you a seat.
We usually stay for about an hour, but you can leave earlier. Some people draw quickly and others take their time.

qs.stem: What should a new visitor do before coming?
opts: Complete a drawing test
Send Marisol a message
Pay a class fee
Ask the café for art supplies
qs.ex: «Send me a message before your first visit so I can save you a seat». Опыт не нужен, платы нет.

qs.stem: Why are visitors asked to buy a drink?
opts: The café provides the meeting space
The café sells drawing paper
Drinks are included in the class fee
The group meets before breakfast
qs.ex: «Please buy a drink because the café lets us use its tables» — кафе даёт место для встреч.

doc.head: FIELDWAY SPORTS
doc.foot:
Your shoes are coming from our other branch. We will send a text when they arrive. Please wait for that message before visiting. Bring this receipt when collecting. If someone collects for you, give them this receipt and tell us their name by phone first.
The service desk is reached through the shop's main entrance. Ask a staff member if you cannot find it.

qs.stem: What should Mia wait for before going to the shop?
opts: A call from the other branch
A request for another payment
A text confirming arrival
A new shoe-size form
qs.ex: «We will send a text when they arrive. Please wait for that message before visiting» — ждать SMS о том, что обувь пришла.

qs.stem: What must Mia do if a friend collects her shoes?
opts: Ask the friend to pay $48
Change the collection date online
Send the friend to the other branch
Tell the shop the friend's name by phone
qs.ex: «If someone collects for you, give them this receipt and tell us their name by phone first».

doc.head: SEEDS FOR YOUR GARDEN
paras: Sunday, March 10, 11 a.m.-1 p.m.
Elm Community Hall

Bring seeds you no longer need and take some different ones home. Put each kind in a separate envelope. Write the plant name on the front. You can join even if you have no seeds to bring. Volunteers can help you choose plants for small gardens or balcony pots. There will be a children's planting table, but an adult must stay with each child.
You may bring photos of plants grown from your seeds, but this is optional. A volunteer will display them on the noticeboard. Empty envelopes will be available at the welcome table.

qs.stem: How should people prepare seeds they bring?
opts: Use separate, named envelopes
Plant them in balcony pots first
Leave envelopes without names
Put all seeds in one large bag
qs.ex: «Put each kind in a separate envelope. Write the plant name on the front» — отдельные подписанные конверты.

qs.stem: Who is allowed to join the exchange?
opts: Only people with large gardens
People who have no seeds to bring
Only experienced gardeners
Only families with children
qs.ex: «You can join even if you have no seeds to bring». Детский стол есть, но участвовать могут не только семьи.

doc.head: NEW WATER STATION
paras: A drinking-water tap is now available beside the west entrance of the station. Use it to fill your own bottle for free. Paper cups are not provided. The tap works from 5 a.m. until the last train leaves at midnight. For hot water, please ask at the café; the new tap supplies cold water only. Keep bags away from the tap so other passengers can reach it easily.
Let station staff know if the tap is not working. Please turn it off after filling your bottle and wipe away any spills.

qs.stem: What should passengers bring to use the free water?
opts: Their own bottle
A café receipt
A first-class train ticket
A paper cup supplied by staff
qs.ex: «Use it to fill your own bottle for free. Paper cups are not provided» — нужна своя бутылка.

qs.stem: Where can passengers ask for hot water?
opts: On the last train only
At the ticket office
At the west-entrance tap
At the café
qs.ex: «For hot water, please ask at the café; the new tap supplies cold water only».

msgs.text: 05 p.m.: I think I left my green notebook at your place yesterday.
09 p.m.: Yes, it's on the chair by the window. Do you need it today?
11 p.m.: Yes, for my evening class. Could you leave it with your sister? I'll pass your house at five.
14 p.m.: She'll be home then. I'll put it on the hall table and tell her you're coming.
15 p.m.: Great, thanks!
17 p.m.: My sister might be cooking when you arrive, so ring the bell twice if she doesn't hear it. She knows which notebook is yours; the other one is blue.

qs.stem: Why does Tessa need the notebook today?
opts: She has an evening class
She is cleaning the hall
She has a meeting at two
She wants to give it to Jon's sister
qs.ex: «Yes, for my evening class».

qs.stem: Who will give Tessa the notebook?
opts: Jon's sister
A neighbor at the window
Jon's teacher
Tessa's classmate
qs.ex: Джон оставит тетрадь дома и предупредит сестру: «Could you leave it with your sister?» — «She'll be home then». Отдаст сестра.

doc.head: TABLES FOR SMALL CELEBRATIONS
paras: Need extra space for guests? Rent a folding table from Meadow Hire. Each table seats six people and costs $10 for a weekend. Collect on Friday after 3 p.m. and return by noon Monday. We do not deliver. Chairs can be rented separately for $2 each. Call us to check availability before coming. Tables fold flat and fit in most cars, but please measure your car space first.
Check the table surface before putting hot dishes on it; we recommend a protective mat. Staff can also show you how the legs lock open when you collect your table.

qs.stem: What is included in the $10 rental?
opts: A table for an entire month
Six chairs and a table
One table for a weekend
Delivery to the customer's home
qs.ex: «Each table seats six people and costs $10 for a weekend». Стулья — отдельно по $2, доставки нет.

qs.stem: When must a rented table be returned?
opts: By noon Sunday
By noon Monday
By midnight Saturday
By 3 p.m. Friday
qs.ex: «Collect on Friday after 3 p.m. and return by noon Monday». 3 p.m. Friday — время, когда стол можно забрать.

doc.head: Westbridge Film Club · Send us your short film!
paras: We are choosing films for our August community screening. Films must be no longer than five minutes and suitable for all ages. You can use a phone camera. Send a link to your film by June 30, with your name and a short description. Do not send large video files by email. Selected filmmakers will be contacted in July. Entry is free, and you may submit one film each.
Films can be stories, animations, or short documentaries about everyday life. Include subtitles if speech is difficult to hear. We will ask permission before using a picture from your film online.

qs.stem: How should people submit their films?
opts: Bring a camera to the screening
Email a large video file in August
Send a link by June 30
Post several films without a name
qs.ex: «Send a link to your film by June 30… Do not send large video files by email».

qs.stem: Which film meets the stated requirements?
opts: A five-minute film for adults only
A ten-minute film made with a phone
A four-minute film suitable for children and adults
A six-minute film suitable for all ages
qs.ex: Требования: не длиннее пяти минут и «suitable for all ages». Подходит только фильм на 4 минуты для детей и взрослых: в остальных нарушена длина или возраст.

doc.head: NOTICE TO COURT USERS
paras: The downstairs changing room will be closed on Tuesday while a broken shower is repaired. Please use the upstairs changing room. The sports courts will open at their normal time of 8 a.m. Towels can be collected from reception as usual. Visitors who cannot use the stairs should speak to reception staff, who can arrange access to a ground-floor room. The downstairs changing room should reopen on Wednesday morning.
Signs beside reception will show the way to the temporary room. Please leave muddy shoes on the mat before entering. Staff will check the signs regularly throughout Tuesday to help visitors.

qs.stem: What will remain available as usual on Tuesday?
opts: The sports courts
The repaired shower from early morning
The downstairs shower
The downstairs changing room
qs.ex: «The sports courts will open at their normal time of 8 a.m.» Нижняя раздевалка и душ во вторник закрыты.

qs.stem: What should a visitor who cannot climb stairs do?
opts: Ask reception for help
Use the broken shower
Wait until all courts close
Collect towels on Wednesday only
qs.ex: «Visitors who cannot use the stairs should speak to reception staff» — обратиться на ресепшен.

doc.subject: Our first meeting
paras: Hi Ben,

I'm looking forward to practicing languages together. Let's meet at the café opposite the bus station on Wednesday at 4 p.m. I will wear a yellow jacket so you can recognize me. We can speak English for the first half hour and Spanish for the next half hour. Bring a photo of a place you like; it will give us something to talk about.
We could also talk about food or music if we run out of ideas. Please send me a message if your bus is delayed. I can wait inside the café.
See you soon,
Lidia

qs.stem: How will Ben recognize Lidia?
opts: By a sign at the bus station
By her Spanish textbook
By a photo on the café wall
By her yellow jacket
qs.ex: «I will wear a yellow jacket so you can recognize me».

qs.stem: What will they do during the second half hour?
opts: Travel to the bus station
Speak Spanish
Buy a yellow jacket
Speak English
qs.ex: «English for the first half hour and Spanish for the next half hour» — вторые полчаса на испанском.

doc.head: RIDGE TOOL CLUB JOINING FORM
doc.foot: Bring the completed form and proof of address to the club desk. New members can borrow one tool at a time for up to seven days. A volunteer will explain how to use it safely before your first loan. Tools must be returned clean. Please call before visiting if you need a particular tool; it may already be on loan. Opening times are printed on the back of the form. Please check that your contact details are readable. We use them to send reminders when borrowed tools are due.

qs.stem: What must applicants bring with the form?
opts: A seven-day travel pass
A tool they own
Proof of address
A safety course certificate
qs.ex: «Bring the completed form and proof of address to the club desk» — подтверждение адреса.

qs.stem: Why should someone call before requesting a particular tool?
opts: All tools need advance cleaning
It may already be borrowed
Membership prices change daily
The club accepts forms only by phone
qs.ex: «Please call before visiting if you need a particular tool; it may already be on loan». On loan = borrowed, уже взят кем-то.

paras: I've finished unpacking and have twelve strong cardboard boxes to give away. Most are medium-sized and all are empty. Pick them up from my garage on Saturday morning, between 9 and 11. Please message me with the number you want. You don't have to take all twelve. I can't keep them after Saturday because I need the garage for my car. You'll need your own transport.
The boxes have some old address labels on them, which you can cover or remove. They are dry and clean. I'll stack the number you request near the garage door.

qs.stem: Why did Nico write the post?
opts: To sell a car
To rent out a garage
To offer a moving service
To give away used moving boxes
qs.ex: Цель поста — отдать коробки: «twelve strong cardboard boxes to give away». Гараж и машина упоминаются, но ничего не продаётся и не сдаётся.

qs.stem: What should interested people include in their message?
opts: How many boxes they want
A request for Sunday delivery
The price they will pay
The size of Nico's car
qs.ex: «Please message me with the number you want» — сколько коробок нужно.

doc.head: NORTH SQUARE - DIGITAL HELP · Tuesday sessions
doc.foot:
Each session is free. Bring your own phone or tablet, fully charged. You may attend more than one session. No booking is needed, but there are only eight seats. If a session is full, staff will give you a place at the next week's session instead. Meet at the information desk.
Staff will explain each step slowly, and you can ask questions. Please do not share passwords with other visitors. You can write down instructions to try again when you get home.

qs.stem: Which session would help someone keep copies of pictures?
opts: The 1:00 session
The 10:00 session
The 2:15 session
The 11:15 session
qs.ex: Сохранять копии фото — это «2:15-3:15: Saving phone photos».

qs.stem: What happens if a session has no seats left?
opts: Visitors must pay to join
Staff offer a place the following week
Staff lend every visitor a tablet
The remaining sessions are canceled
qs.ex: «If a session is full, staff will give you a place at the next week's session instead» — место на следующей неделе.

doc.subject: Your Sunday booking
paras: Dear Ava,

Your booking for two bicycles on Sunday is confirmed. Collect them between 9 and 10 a.m. from our beach kiosk, not the town shop where you made the booking. Helmets are included. You have paid the hire fee, but a refundable $25 deposit per bicycle is due at collection. We accept cards only at the kiosk. Return the bicycles by 5 p.m. to the same place. If strong winds make the coastal route unsafe, we will text you before 8 a.m. and offer a different route or a refund.
We can provide a route map on request. Please check the brakes with our attendant before leaving the kiosk.
Coast Cycle Hire

qs.stem: Where should Ava collect the bicycles?
opts: At her accommodation
At the start of the alternative route
At the beach kiosk
At the town shop
qs.ex: «…from our beach kiosk, not the town shop where you made the booking». Магазин в городе — ловушка: там велосипеды бронировали.

qs.stem: What payment is required when Ava collects both bicycles?
opts: A second hire fee by card
A $25 total deposit in cash
No payment because everything is paid
A $50 refundable deposit by card
qs.ex: Залог $25 «per bicycle» → за два велосипеда $50, и «We accept cards only at the kiosk» — картой. Плата за прокат уже внесена.

qs.stem: What can Ava expect if the coastal route is unsafe?
opts: A text confirming the coastal route after arrival
Automatic cancellation without notice
A message before collection with alternatives
A guaranteed coastal ride at noon
qs.ex: «…we will text you before 8 a.m. and offer a different route or a refund», то есть сообщение придёт до выдачи (9–10 a.m.) с вариантами.

doc.head: Pine Street Station - Lift Maintenance
paras: The lift to Platform 2 will be unavailable from April 16 to April 18. Trains will run normally. Passengers who need step-free access should travel from nearby Lake Station, where the same services stop. A free shuttle will connect the two stations every twenty minutes between 6 a.m. and 10 p.m. Show your train ticket to the driver; no separate shuttle ticket is needed. The stairs at Pine Street remain open. Staff will help with small bags, but cannot carry passengers or heavy luggage. Allow extra travel time if using the shuttle.
The shuttle stops beside each station entrance. Staff at the information desk can point you toward the correct boarding location.

qs.stem: What is the main purpose of this notice?
opts: To change the fare at Lake Station
To announce that all trains are canceled
To advertise a new heavy-luggage service
To explain access arrangements during lift maintenance
qs.ex: Объявление объясняет, как добраться без лифта: соседняя станция, бесплатный шаттл, помощь персонала. Поезда при этом ходят обычно, так что «all trains are canceled» — неверно.

qs.stem: What is needed to use the free shuttle?
opts: A lift-maintenance pass
A train ticket
A request submitted twenty minutes earlier
A separate shuttle ticket
qs.ex: «Show your train ticket to the driver; no separate shuttle ticket is needed».

qs.stem: Which passenger would most likely need the shuttle?
opts: Someone who cannot use stairs and needs Platform 2
Someone collecting a small bag from staff
Someone who prefers to buy tickets on the shuttle
Someone taking a train that does not stop at Lake Station
qs.ex: Шаттл нужен тем, кому нужен доступ без ступенек: лифт к Platform 2 не работает, а лестница открыта. Значит, это пассажир, который не может подняться по лестнице и едет с Platform 2.

msgs.text: 02: Have we ordered Daniel's leaving gift yet?
04: Not yet. The photo book needs everyone's pictures by tonight if it is to arrive Friday.
06: I can upload mine after work. Is the café voucher still part of the gift?
08: Yes. We have enough money for both, but not for express delivery as well.
10: Then let's remind everyone now. I don't want to hand him an empty bag!
12: I'll send a message. If the book misses Friday, we can give him the voucher first.
14: Please choose clear photos without filters. The printer warned that very dark images may lose detail in the book.

qs.stem: What must happen for the book to arrive by Friday?
opts: The group must cancel the voucher
Daniel must choose a café today
Everyone must provide pictures by tonight
Ruth must pay for express delivery
qs.ex: «The photo book needs everyone's pictures by tonight if it is to arrive Friday».

qs.stem: What does Ruth mean by "an empty bag"?
opts: Buying packaging that is too large
Asking Daniel to return a bag
Forgetting to collect everyone's money
Having no physical gift ready to give
qs.ex: Рут не хочет вручать Даниэлю пустой пакет, то есть остаться без подарка, который можно вручить. Это переносное значение, речь не о размере упаковки.

qs.stem: What is the backup plan if the book arrives late?
opts: Give Daniel the voucher first
Choose a different leaving date
Use express delivery regardless of cost
Give Daniel money instead of either gift
qs.ex: «If the book misses Friday, we can give him the voucher first».

paras: Help choose our next outdoor film.

This month's shortlist is now on the Brookfield Cinema website. Residents may vote for one film until Sunday evening. You need an email address to vote, but there is no membership requirement. The film with the most votes will be shown in the park on August 23, provided we can obtain screening permission. If permission is refused, the runner-up will be selected. Bring your own seat; refreshments will be sold on site. In wet weather, the screening will move to the school hall, which has fewer seats. Updates will appear online by noon that day.
Visitors are welcome to bring picnic food. Please use the bins afterward so the park is ready for its usual morning users.

qs.stem: Who can vote for a film?
opts: Only people who bring their own seat
Residents who buy refreshments in advance
Only paid cinema members
Residents with an email address
qs.ex: «You need an email address to vote, but there is no membership requirement».

qs.stem: Why might the most popular film not be shown?
opts: Its voters might not buy refreshments
All outdoor films might require membership
The organizers might not obtain permission
The school hall might have no website
qs.ex: «…provided we can obtain screening permission. If permission is refused, the runner-up will be selected». Provided = при условии, что.

qs.stem: What should a visitor do to check a wet-weather change?
opts: Vote again on Sunday evening
Call the school after the film
Look online by noon on August 23
Visit the park before voting ends
qs.ex: «Updates will appear online by noon that day» — в день показа (23 августа) нужно проверить сайт до полудня.

doc.head: WINDOW WORKS - SUMMER OFFER
paras: Order curtains before June 12 and receive a free home measuring visit. Fabric and fitting are charged at the usual rates. The offer covers homes within ten kilometers of our shop. Outside that area, a travel charge applies even during the promotion. Samples can be borrowed for three days against a $10 deposit, returned when the samples come back undamaged. Production normally takes two weeks after you approve the measurements and fabric choice. Booking a measuring visit does not commit you to ordering curtains. Call to arrange a visit; online messages may take two working days to answer.
Our measuring team carries identification, which you can ask to see. Visits usually take twenty minutes, depending on the number of windows.

qs.stem: What is free under the promotion for a nearby home?
opts: The fitting service
The measuring visit
The sample deposit
The curtain fabric
qs.ex: «Order curtains before June 12 and receive a free home measuring visit». Ткань и установка — «at the usual rates».

qs.stem: When does the normal production period begin?
opts: When samples are first borrowed
On June 12 for every customer
When an online message is sent
After measurements and fabric are approved
qs.ex: «Production normally takes two weeks after you approve the measurements and fabric choice».

qs.stem: What can a customer do after a measuring visit?
opts: Decide not to order curtains
Avoid travel charges outside the area
Demand free fitting
Keep samples indefinitely
qs.ex: «Booking a measuring visit does not commit you to ordering curtains» — можно отказаться от заказа.

doc.subject: Collection rota
paras: Hello everyone,

Saturday's donated-food collection will start at 8:30 rather than 9 because the bakery is opening earlier. Drivers should come straight to the bakery. Sorting volunteers should still report to the community warehouse at 9; there will be nothing to sort before the first van arrives. We have enough drivers, but need one more person to label boxes. This role involves standing for about an hour and requires no lifting. Please reply by Thursday if you can help with labeling. Anyone unable to attend should contact me directly rather than asking another volunteer to cover without telling me.
Labeling volunteers will work beside the sorting tables. We will provide marker pens and a short guide to the categories used.
Amira

qs.stem: Who should start at 8:30 on Saturday?
opts: The sorting volunteers
All warehouse visitors
Only the person labeling boxes
The drivers
qs.ex: Сбор начинается в 8:30, и «Drivers should come straight to the bakery». Сортировщики приходят к 9.

qs.stem: Why does Amira mention that labeling requires no lifting?
opts: To clarify the physical demands of an open role
To explain why the bakery opens early
To announce that all boxes will be empty
To tell drivers not to load their vans
qs.ex: Амира ищет человека на маркировку коробок и уточняет, что придётся стоять около часа, но поднимать ничего не нужно, — описывает физическую нагрузку на этой роли.

qs.stem: What should a volunteer who cannot attend do?
opts: Arrange a replacement without notifying Amira
Contact Amira directly
Reply only to the bakery
Wait until Saturday to tell a driver
qs.ex: «Anyone unable to attend should contact me directly rather than asking another volunteer to cover without telling me».

doc.head: HARBOR FERRY - SATURDAY SERVICE
doc.foot:
Return departures from island: 10:00, 12:00, 16:00
Journey time: 25 minutes each way Buy return tickets at the town terminal before boarding. Online tickets are valid for any departure that day but do not reserve a seat. Boarding closes five minutes before departure. The island café opens at 10 and closes at 15. Bicycles travel free when space permits; passengers with bicycles board after those traveling on foot. Weather cancellations are posted on our website, not on the café's page.
Large suitcases should be placed in the marked luggage area. Please keep the cabin aisle clear while the ferry is moving.

qs.stem: When does boarding close for the 11:00 ferry?
qs.ex: «Boarding closes five minutes before departure» → 11:00 − 5 минут = 10:55.

qs.stem: What is true for someone holding an online ticket?
opts: They must use the 9:00 departure
They can check cancellations only at the café
They may still be unable to board a full ferry
They have a seat on every departure
qs.ex: «Online tickets are valid for any departure that day but do not reserve a seat». Место не гарантировано, значит, на полный паром можно не попасть.

qs.stem: Which return departure is available after the café closes?
qs.ex: Кафе закрывается в 15 (3 p.m.). Из обратных рейсов (10:00, 12:00, 16:00) после этого остаётся только 16:00.

doc.head: Cypress Road Saturday Market
paras: Please clear the marked parking bays by 7 a.m. on market days so traders can set up safely. Vehicles may return after 4 p.m., once the stalls have been removed. The rule applies only to bays marked with yellow market signs; parking on the opposite side of the road is unchanged. Residents can use the school car park free between 6 a.m. and 5 p.m. on Saturdays by displaying their street parking permit. Do not leave vehicles there overnight: the gates are locked at 5:15 p.m. Access to private driveways will remain available throughout the market.
Traders will place temporary signs at the ends of the affected bays. Please do not move them when parking nearby.

qs.stem: Which parking spaces must be cleared for the market?
opts: Bays marked with yellow market signs
Only the school car park spaces
All private driveways
All spaces on both sides of the road
qs.ex: «The rule applies only to bays marked with yellow market signs; parking on the opposite side of the road is unchanged».

qs.stem: What lets residents park free at the school on Saturday?
opts: Displaying their street parking permit
Showing a market shopping receipt
Arriving after the gates are locked
Booking a stall at the market
qs.ex: «…free between 6 a.m. and 5 p.m. on Saturdays by displaying their street parking permit».

qs.stem: Why should residents remove cars from the school before evening?
opts: Private driveways close at 5 p.m.
Their street permits expire at 4 p.m.
They could lose access when the gates lock
The market continues there overnight
qs.ex: «Do not leave vehicles there overnight: the gates are locked at 5:15 p.m.» Если не забрать машину, к ней не будет доступа до открытия ворот.

doc.subject: Interview arrangements
paras: Dear Leo,

We would like to invite you to an interview for our weekend sales role on Tuesday at 3 p.m. Please come to the office above the shop, using the door beside the florist. The shop entrance will be busy with customers. Bring a copy of your résumé and the names of two people who can describe your work or study habits. They do not need to have employed you. If the proposed time conflicts with a class, reply by Monday morning; we have some Wednesday appointments available. The interview should take about thirty minutes.
Please allow time to find the office entrance. If you arrive early, ring the bell and wait for a staff member.
Fern Books

qs.stem: Which entrance should Leo use?
opts: The door beside the florist
The delivery entrance behind the shop
The main shop entrance
The florist's customer entrance
qs.ex: «…using the door beside the florist. The shop entrance will be busy with customers».

qs.stem: Who could Leo list as a reference?
opts: A teacher who knows his study habits
Only a former employer
Only an employee of Fern Books
Any customer visiting on Tuesday
qs.ex: Нужны люди, «who can describe your work or study habits. They do not need to have employed you». Подходит учитель, который знает, как Лео учится.

qs.stem: What should Leo do if he has a class at the interview time?
opts: Go to the shop on Wednesday without replying
Arrive thirty minutes late without notice
Ask the florist to interview him
Reply by Monday morning
qs.ex: «If the proposed time conflicts with a class, reply by Monday morning».

paras: We have one spare place at Friday's cooking evening because a member is away. We'll prepare a vegetarian meal together, then eat at around 8. Beginners are welcome; this is about sharing skills, not showing off. The $12 contribution covers ingredients. Please let me know about food allergies before accepting the place so we can check the menu. Bring a container if you'd like to take leftovers home, although there may not be any. Message me directly rather than commenting below: I don't always see comments. I'll confirm the place with the first person whose dietary needs we can accommodate.
We'll cook in pairs so everyone gets involved. Aprons are available, but please wear clothes that won't suffer from a small spill.

qs.stem: What does "showing off" mean in this post?
opts: Trying to impress others with one's abilities
Leaving the meal before it starts
Displaying the menu for guests
Showing someone where to sit
qs.ex: «This is about sharing skills, not showing off». Show off — хвастаться, пытаться впечатлить других своими умениями.

qs.stem: Why should interested people mention allergies first?
opts: To guarantee leftovers
To check whether the menu can meet their needs
To avoid having to cook
To receive a lower ingredient charge
qs.ex: «Please let me know about food allergies before accepting the place so we can check the menu».

qs.stem: Who will receive the spare place?
opts: The most experienced cook
The first person to post any public comment
The earliest direct respondent whose needs can be met
Anyone bringing a container
qs.ex: «I'll confirm the place with the first person whose dietary needs we can accommodate», а писать нужно в личные сообщения, не в комментарии.

doc.head: NORTHLIGHT CAMERA SERVICE
doc.foot:
Your camera is ready for collection. The discounted total applies if payment reaches us by the deadline; after that, the standard total of $50 is payable. Pay by bank transfer using invoice 619 as the reference, or by card in the shop. The camera can be collected before payment, but the deadline remains unchanged. A six-month warranty covers the new strap. Cleaning is a service and is not included in that warranty.
We can email a payment confirmation if requested. Please check the invoice number when contacting us so we locate your record.

qs.stem: How much is payable after September 9?
qs.ex: «…after that, the standard total of $50 is payable». $45 — цена со скидкой до дедлайна.

qs.stem: What should Yasmin use as the bank-transfer reference?
opts: September 9
The amount of the discount
The strap's warranty period
Invoice 619
qs.ex: «Pay by bank transfer using invoice 619 as the reference».

qs.stem: What is true if Yasmin collects the camera before paying?
opts: The original payment deadline still applies
The total becomes $35
The cleaning gains a warranty
Collection starts a new six-month payment period
qs.ex: «The camera can be collected before payment, but the deadline remains unchanged» — дедлайн 9 сентября остаётся.

doc.subject: Before your first walk
paras: Hello,

Thank you for offering to walk our dogs. Before booking a walking shift, attend one introductory session. Sessions run on Tuesday evenings and Saturday mornings; choose either, not both. We will show you how to fit a lead and explain which paths to use. You should wear sturdy shoes and clothes you can wash easily. For your first two shifts, an experienced volunteer will walk with you. After that, staff will decide which dogs you can walk independently. Please do not bring your own pet to the introduction, as this can distract the shelter dogs.
Training includes a short walk around the grounds. Please tell the session leader beforehand if you need an accessible route for this.
Shelter Team

qs.stem: What must volunteers do before booking a shift?
opts: Complete two independent walks
Attend both weekly introductions
Bring their own dog for assessment
Attend one introduction
qs.ex: «Before booking a walking shift, attend one introductory session… choose either, not both».

qs.stem: Who accompanies a new volunteer on the first two shifts?
opts: No one
The volunteer's own pet
An experienced volunteer
A member of the public
qs.ex: «For your first two shifts, an experienced volunteer will walk with you».

qs.stem: Why are volunteers asked not to bring their pets?
opts: To avoid distracting the shelter dogs
To make the walks longer
To reduce the number of introductions
To ensure all shoes stay clean
qs.ex: «Please do not bring your own pet to the introduction, as this can distract the shelter dogs».

doc.head: TOWN MUSIC WEEKEND - REFUNDS
paras: Unused wristbands can be refunded at the ticket office until Thursday at 6 p.m. Bring the original purchase receipt. A wristband that has been cut or worn cannot be refunded, even if you attended no performances. Online buyers should request refunds through their account instead of visiting the office. Refunds go to the original payment method and may take five working days. If you bought several wristbands in one order, you may return only the unused ones. Wristbands can be transferred to another person before use; let us know the new name before the festival opens on Friday.
Please keep wristbands away from moisture before the event. Damaged barcodes may delay entry while staff check the original booking record.

qs.stem: Where should online buyers request a refund?
opts: From the person receiving a transferred band
Through their online account
At a performance entrance
At the ticket office
qs.ex: «Online buyers should request refunds through their account instead of visiting the office».

qs.stem: Which wristband could qualify for a refund?
opts: A cut wristband returned before Thursday
A worn wristband never used at a performance
An unused wristband returned after the deadline
An unused, uncut wristband returned with the receipt on time
qs.ex: Нужны все условия сразу: браслет не использован и не разрезан, есть чек, возврат до четверга 6 p.m. В остальных вариантах нарушено одно из них.

qs.stem: What must happen before a wristband is transferred?
opts: The organizer must be told the new name before opening
The refund must arrive in five days
Every wristband in the order must be returned
The recipient must cut the band
qs.ex: «Wristbands can be transferred… let us know the new name before the festival opens on Friday».

msgs.text: 40: The bakery says our cake is ready, but they close at four today. Can you collect it?
43: I finish work at three. I can go straight there. Have you paid?
45: Yes. Ask for the order under my name. Keep the box flat; the decorations are delicate.
47: I'll put it on the car floor, then. Should I take it to the restaurant?
49: Please bring it to my flat instead. The restaurant won't store outside food before six.
51: Fine. I'll call when I'm downstairs.
53: I'll drive carefully and avoid the rough road near the park. Please clear a space in your fridge before I arrive.

qs.stem: Why does the cake need to be collected before four?
opts: The order must be paid then
Noor finishes work then
The bakery closes then
The restaurant starts dinner then
qs.ex: «…they close at four today».

qs.stem: What does "delicate" describe about the decorations?
opts: They need extra payment
They can be damaged easily
They are difficult to recognize
They are very large
