qs.stem: Where should Ethan take the cake after collection?
opts: Directly to the restaurant
To his workplace
Back to the bakery after six
To Noor's flat
qs.ex: «Please bring it to my flat instead. The restaurant won't store outside food before six».

doc.head: HILL ROAD CLOTHING · CLEARANCE WEEK
paras: Selected jackets are half price until Saturday. Sizes shown online reflect yesterday's stock and may sell out during the day. Call the shop to reserve an item for collection; adding it to an online wish list does not hold it. Reservations last until closing on the next working day. If you need longer, speak to staff before your hold expires. Sale items can be exchanged for another size within fourteen days if tags are attached, but refunds are available only for faulty goods. Keep your receipt. Home delivery is unavailable for clearance stock, although regular-price items can still be shipped.
Reserved items can be tried on at collection before purchase. Staff will confirm the current price, since the promotion ends Saturday.

qs.stem: How can a customer hold a clearance jacket?
opts: Request regular-price home delivery
Call the shop to reserve it
Wait for the stock list to update
Add it to an online wish list
qs.ex: «Call the shop to reserve an item for collection; adding it to an online wish list does not hold it».

qs.stem: Why might a size listed online be unavailable?
opts: The sale has already ended
The displayed stock information is not live
Online customers must buy two jackets
All online sizes are samples only
qs.ex: «Sizes shown online reflect yesterday's stock and may sell out during the day» — данные на сайте не обновляются в реальном времени.

qs.stem: When may a customer obtain a refund for a sale jacket?
opts: Whenever the customer changes their mind
Only after fourteen days
When the jacket is faulty
Whenever tags have been removed
qs.ex: «…refunds are available only for faulty goods». Обмен на другой размер возможен, а деньги возвращают только за брак.

doc.head: MILL COURT - FLOOR REPAIRS
paras: The front lobby will be closed from 9 a.m. to 3 p.m. on Thursday while new floor tiles are fitted. Residents should use the garden entrance during that period. The door code is the same as at the front entrance. Deliveries arriving during the work will be directed to the garden gate; please update any delivery instructions you have saved online. The garden path is narrow, so bicycles must be pushed rather than ridden. Emergency access will be maintained. If you normally receive a visitor who needs assistance, contact the caretaker by Wednesday evening to discuss the temporary route.
The caretaker will put directional signs along the temporary route. Please avoid leaving bags near the garden door during the work.

qs.stem: What should residents do about expected deliveries?
opts: Ask drivers to use a new door code
Cancel every delivery for the week
Update saved instructions for the garden gate
Leave parcels in the front lobby
qs.ex: «Deliveries arriving during the work will be directed to the garden gate; please update any delivery instructions you have saved online».

qs.stem: How should bicycles be moved along the garden path?
opts: They should be carried by the caretaker
They should be ridden quickly
They should be pushed
They should be left at the front entrance
qs.ex: «The garden path is narrow, so bicycles must be pushed rather than ridden».

qs.stem: Why should a resident contact the caretaker about a visitor needing assistance?
opts: To obtain a permanent new door code
To ask for a delivery refund
To plan access along the temporary route
To prevent emergency vehicles entering
qs.ex: «…contact the caretaker by Wednesday evening to discuss the temporary route» — обсудить, как пройти временным путём.

doc.subject: Saturday street survey
paras: Hello team,

Please meet outside the town hall at 9:15 on Saturday. We will divide into pairs and collect pedestrian counts at four nearby crossings. Each pair needs one phone with a timer and one clipboard; clipboards will be supplied. Do not record people's faces or names. We are counting movement, not identifying individuals. If rain is heavy, we will postpone the survey to Sunday rather than collect data under very different conditions. I will email any postponement by 7:30 Saturday morning. If you cannot work Sunday, tell me now so I can plan replacement pairs in advance.
Counts will be entered on a shared form afterward. Please write clearly and note the crossing location on each clipboard sheet.
Daria

qs.stem: What equipment must each pair provide?
opts: A list of pedestrian names
One phone with a timer
Two clipboards
A camera for recording faces
qs.ex: «Each pair needs one phone with a timer and one clipboard; clipboards will be supplied». Планшеты выдадут, а телефон нужен свой.

qs.stem: Why would heavy rain lead to postponement?
opts: The town hall cannot send emails in rain
Clipboards can be used only on Sundays
All pedestrians have already been counted
It would substantially change the survey conditions
qs.ex: «…rather than collect data under very different conditions» — в сильный дождь условия подсчёта слишком изменятся, данные будет не сравнить.

qs.stem: Who should contact Daria before Saturday?
opts: Anyone expecting an email at 9:15
An assistant unavailable on Sunday
Only assistants who own clipboards
Every pedestrian using a crossing
qs.ex: «If you cannot work Sunday, tell me now so I can plan replacement pairs».

doc.head: RIVER MUSEUM AUDIO GUIDE LOAN
doc.foot: Return your guide to the audio desk before leaving. Deposits are refunded only after staff check that the guide and headphones are complete and working. The audio desk closes at 5:30, thirty minutes before the museum. If you return later, use the reception desk; reception can record the return but cannot process card refunds. In that case, your deposit will be refunded the next working day. Keep this receipt until the money reaches your account. Lost guides may incur a replacement charge greater than the deposit. A staff member will demonstrate the volume control when issuing the guide. Please use headphones rather than playing audio aloud in galleries.

qs.stem: How much of the payment is normally refundable?
qs.ex: Залог $20 — «refundable», плата за аренду $4 не возвращается. $24 — вся сумма.

qs.stem: Where should a visitor return the guide at 5:45?
opts: At the next day's entrance queue
At reception
At the museum café
At the closed audio desk
qs.ex: Стойка аудиогидов закрывается в 5:30, поэтому в 5:45 сдают на ресепшен: «If you return later, use the reception desk».

qs.stem: What happens after a late return to reception?
opts: The museum remains open until the refund arrives
The visitor must buy the guide
A card refund will be processed the next working day
The deposit automatically becomes a hire fee
qs.ex: «…reception can record the return but cannot process card refunds. In that case, your deposit will be refunded the next working day».

doc.head: WORK NEAR HOME
paras: Grove Rooms offers day desks from Monday to Friday, 8 a.m.-6 p.m. A $16 day pass includes Wi-Fi, tea, and a shared quiet workspace. Phone calls must be taken in the corridor booth, which can be booked for twenty minutes at a time. Printing costs extra. Book online by 6 p.m. the previous day; walk-in access depends on spare desks. You may leave for lunch and return using your day-pass code. The pass is for one named user and cannot be shared with a colleague. Monthly members have priority for the two private meeting rooms.
Charging sockets are available beside each desk, but cables are not supplied. Please bring the charger appropriate for your device with you.

qs.stem: Which service costs extra?
opts: Returning after lunch
Tea
Wi-Fi
Printing
qs.ex: «Printing costs extra». Wi-Fi и чай входят в дневной пропуск.

qs.stem: Where should a day-pass user make phone calls?
opts: Only in a private meeting room
In the corridor booth
In the quiet workspace if speaking softly
At any quiet-workspace desk
qs.ex: «Phone calls must be taken in the corridor booth».

qs.stem: What can a person arriving without a booking expect?
opts: Entry only if a desk is available
A pass that can be shared
Priority over monthly meeting-room users
Guaranteed entry because a pass costs $16
qs.ex: «…walk-in access depends on spare desks» — без брони пустят, только если есть свободный стол.

paras: Our apple harvest is Saturday from 10 until noon. Volunteers will work in small teams, with one trained person handling each ladder. Everyone else can collect fallen fruit or sort apples at ground level. Please bring work gloves and a reusable bag. We will share sound apples among volunteers after setting aside the quantity promised to the food pantry. Bruised fruit will go to a local juice maker, so please don't discard it. If you can stay for cleanup, message me; we particularly need help folding tables. Children are welcome with an adult but must not climb the ladders.
Please keep different fruit categories in separate crates. Team leaders will explain the sorting labels before work begins at the orchard.

qs.stem: Who may handle a ladder during the harvest?
opts: Any child accompanied by an adult
A trained team member
Only the juice maker
Anyone bringing a reusable bag
qs.ex: «…with one trained person handling each ladder». Детям лестницы запрещены.

qs.stem: What does "sound" mean in "sound apples"?
opts: Recently bought
Unusually heavy
Making a noise
In good condition
qs.ex: Sound apples — целые, хорошие яблоки, в отличие от bruised fruit (побитых). Значение «звук» здесь не подходит.

qs.stem: What will happen before apples are shared among volunteers?
opts: All bruised fruit will be thrown away
The pantry's promised amount will be reserved
Children will finish climbing ladders
Every volunteer will fold a table
qs.ex: «We will share sound apples among volunteers after setting aside the quantity promised to the food pantry».

doc.subject: Options following your cabin booking
paras: Dear Ms. Bell,

A burst pipe has closed your cabin for the first night. We can offer a larger hill cabin free, instead of your lakeside one. You may remain there for the entire stay or move to your original cabin the following afternoon. If you choose to move, we will transfer your bags, although you must vacate the hill cabin by 10 a.m.; the lakeside cabin will not be ready until 2 p.m. Alternatively, you may cancel for a full refund. Please reply by noon tomorrow. We will hold the hill cabin until then, but will not treat silence as acceptance. Your paid lake-activity bookings are unaffected unless you cancel the whole stay.
Check-in instructions will accompany our booking confirmation.
Juniper Holiday Park

qs.stem: What inconvenience comes with moving to the original cabin?
opts: Having to carry all bags without help
A four-hour gap between cabin access times
An extra charge for the larger cabin
Losing every lake-activity booking
qs.ex: Освободить hill cabin нужно до 10 a.m., а lakeside cabin будет готов только к 2 p.m., то есть четыре часа без домика. Сумки перенесут, так что «carry all bags without help» неверно.

qs.stem: What must Ms. Bell do to secure the hill cabin?
opts: Pay the price difference immediately
Accept the offer before the reply deadline
Wait without replying until arrival
Cancel her lake activities
qs.ex: «We will hold the hill cabin until then, but will not treat silence as acceptance» — нужно принять предложение до полудня завтра. Доплаты нет: «free».

qs.stem: Why does the email mention paid lake activities?
opts: To indicate that changing cabins cancels those activities
To clarify which bookings the cabin problem affects
To persuade Ms. Bell to buy more activities
To announce a separate activity refund
qs.ex: «Your paid lake-activity bookings are unaffected unless you cancel the whole stay» — автор уточняет, каких бронирований касается проблема с домиком.

doc.head: East Borough - Recycling Collection
paras: During the depot refit, glass collections will take place twice monthly instead of weekly. Residents whose usual glass day is Tuesday should use the first and third Tuesdays of each month; Thursday routes will use the second and fourth Thursdays. In months with a fifth collection day, no additional glass pickup is scheduled. Overflow glass may go to the supermarket collection point. Businesses must use contracted services. Do not leave glass beside a full communal bin: crews cannot safely collect loose items. The revised timetable begins May 1 and is expected to end in July. That end date is provisional, so retain this notice until a replacement schedule is issued. Collection alerts in the borough app will be updated, although previously downloaded calendars will not change automatically.
Please rinse bottles before placing them in bins.

qs.stem: What should a Tuesday-route resident expect on a fifth Tuesday?
opts: Collection only for businesses
No scheduled glass collection
An extra collection for every material
Automatic pickup of loose overflow glass
qs.ex: «In months with a fifth collection day, no additional glass pickup is scheduled» — в пятый вторник вывоза не будет.

qs.stem: Why should residents keep the notice after the expected refit period?
opts: Paper collections will stop in July
All app alerts are being discontinued
The temporary schedule may continue beyond July
The supermarket point will become business-only
qs.ex: «That end date is provisional, so retain this notice» — июль только предварительная дата, график может продлиться.

qs.stem: Which information will not update automatically?
opts: A calendar downloaded earlier
Collection alerts in the borough app
A new calendar downloaded after revision
The timetable printed on a replacement notice
qs.ex: «…previously downloaded calendars will not change automatically». Уведомления в приложении обновятся.

msgs.text: 02: The sofa is yours. The photograph looks gray, but the fabric is pale green.
06: That's fine. Can your building lift take it?
09: The lift is too narrow; bring someone to help on the stairs. I can hold doors, but my wrist means I can't lift anything.
12: My brother is free Saturday. Could we come at eleven?
15: Yes, provided you're finished by noon. The loading bay is booked for a delivery after that.
18: Would you accept $80 rather than $90?
22: If you take it Saturday, yes. Otherwise I'll leave the listing up.
24: The feet unscrew for easier handling.

qs.stem: What must Cal arrange to remove the sofa?
opts: A booking for the building lift
A delivery after noon
Mina's help with lifting
Someone to help carry it down the stairs
qs.ex: «The lift is too narrow; bring someone to help on the stairs». Мина держит двери, но поднимать не может.

qs.stem: Under what condition will Mina accept $80?
opts: If the fabric matches the photograph
If Cal keeps the sofa listed online
If her wrist has recovered
If Cal collects the sofa on Saturday
qs.ex: «If you take it Saturday, yes» — $80 при условии, что Кэл заберёт диван в субботу.

qs.stem: Why does Mina correct the apparent fabric color?
opts: To claim that the photograph is of a different sofa
To justify refusing a lower price
To prevent a mistaken expectation before collection
To explain why the lift is narrow
qs.ex: На фото диван серый, а на самом деле светло-зелёный. Мина уточняет цвет заранее, чтобы у Кэла не было неверных ожиданий.

doc.head: Alder Reserve - Proposed Trail Diversion
paras: We are seeking comments on a proposal to divert the lower loop trail away from nesting birds between March and June. The alternative route would add about fifteen minutes and include a short steep section. The upper loop would remain open. This is a consultation, not a closure notice: no diversion will begin before the board reviews responses next month. Comments should describe how the proposal would affect your use of the reserve, especially if the steep section creates an access barrier. Support or opposition is welcome; practical examples help us compare alternatives. Please respond by February 14. Reports of immediate wildlife disturbance should go to the ranger by phone rather than through this consultation form, which is checked only twice weekly.
Responses may be submitted anonymously if preferred.

qs.stem: What is the current status of the lower loop?
opts: It has permanently become the upper loop
It is open only to board members
It remains open while a proposed change is considered
It has already closed until June
qs.ex: «This is a consultation, not a closure notice: no diversion will begin before the board reviews responses». Тропа пока открыта.

qs.stem: Why are respondents asked for practical examples?
opts: To report urgent disturbances through the form
To avoid allowing expressions of opposition
To help assess effects and compare route options
To prove they own land in the reserve
qs.ex: «Practical examples help us compare alternatives» — примеры помогают оценить, как изменение повлияет на людей, и сравнить варианты маршрута.

qs.stem: How should someone report birds being disturbed right now?
opts: Use the consultation form as the urgent channel
Submit only a route map
Wait for next month's board review
Phone the ranger
qs.ex: «Reports of immediate wildlife disturbance should go to the ranger by phone». Форму проверяют только дважды в неделю.

doc.head: HOMEFIX APPLIANCE PLAN
paras: For $8 a month, members receive one annual inspection and pay no callout fee for repairs to listed kitchen appliances. Parts and repair labor are billed separately. Appliances must be working when added to the plan; joining after a fault appears does not cover that existing problem. Coverage begins fourteen days after registration, except for the inspection, which can be booked immediately. The plan does not guarantee that an old appliance can be repaired economically. If our technician recommends replacement, you may request a second opinion without losing membership benefits. Cancel with thirty days' notice. Unused inspections cannot be exchanged for cash. Homes outside our service area are ineligible, even if owners bring appliances to our workshop. Check your postcode before submitting payment.
Inspection reminders are sent by email to members.

qs.stem: Which benefit is available immediately after registration?
opts: Booking the annual inspection
Cash in place of an unused inspection
Waiver of all parts charges
Free repair labor for an existing fault
qs.ex: «Coverage begins fourteen days after registration, except for the inspection, which can be booked immediately».

qs.stem: What does membership mean if a covered appliance is costly to repair?
opts: A second opinion requires giving up the plan benefits
A successful repair is guaranteed
Replacement may still be recommended
All repair costs become part of the monthly fee
qs.ex: «The plan does not guarantee that an old appliance can be repaired economically. If our technician recommends replacement…» — даже с планом могут посоветовать замену.

qs.stem: Who is ineligible for the plan?
opts: An owner canceling with thirty days' notice
An owner booking an inspection immediately
An owner requesting a second opinion
An owner outside the service area who can bring an appliance in
qs.ex: «Homes outside our service area are ineligible, even if owners bring appliances to our workshop».

doc.subject: Amplified music at evening bookings
paras: Dear organizers,

Following complaints from nearby residents, amplified music must now finish by 9:30 p.m., even when your hall booking runs later. Unamplified conversation and cleanup may continue until the booked end time. Closing exterior doors will reduce sound, but does not permit an extension of the music deadline. Groups that previously advertised later performances may revise their program or cancel without the usual charge if they contact us within seven days. The fee exemption applies only to bookings made before today's notice, not to new reservations. Please brief any hired performers yourself; the hall does not hold their contact details. Staff can lend a basic sound meter, but organizers remain responsible for complying with the cutoff, regardless of the reading shown.
Please include your booking reference when contacting us.
Hall Coordinator

qs.stem: What may continue after 9:30 during a later booking?
opts: Any performance advertised earlier
Amplified music with exterior doors closed
Amplified music below a meter reading
Conversation without amplification and cleanup
qs.ex: «Unamplified conversation and cleanup may continue until the booked end time». Закрытые двери срок для музыки не продлевают.

qs.stem: Which organizer could avoid the cancellation charge?
opts: One canceling an earlier booking a month later
One making a new booking after reading the notice
One with an earlier booking who contacts the hall within seven days
One who tells performers but never contacts the hall
qs.ex: Без сбора можно отменить, если бронь сделана до сегодняшнего письма и связаться с залом «within seven days». Новые брони льготы не получают.

qs.stem: Why must organizers brief hired performers?
opts: Performers are exempt if their details are not recorded
The hall cannot contact them directly
The new rule applies only to performers hired after the notice
Performers determine the music cutoff
qs.ex: «…the hall does not hold their contact details» — зал не может сам связаться с исполнителями.

doc.head: MAPLE CATERING - REVISED INVOICE
doc.foot:
Please pay the balance by October 8, quoting event reference NF12. The five-lunch reduction was received before our final-number deadline and is reflected above. Further reductions cannot lower the invoice, though additional lunches may be ordered until October 10, subject to kitchen capacity. The delivery charge covers bringing the food to the building entrance, not carrying it upstairs. Please arrange helpers if your event is on another floor. The reusable trays should be returned within three days; disposable cutlery and napkins do not need to be returned.
Label returned trays with the event reference.

qs.stem: What does the $220 figure represent?
opts: The total cost before any payments
The outstanding amount after the reduction and deposit
The charge for thirty lunches alone
The refundable value of the trays
qs.ex: 360 − 60 + 20 − 100 = $220 — остаток к оплате после уменьшения заказа и депозита.

qs.stem: What happens if the organizer now needs fewer lunches?
opts: The amount due will not fall further
Every unused lunch will receive a $12 credit
The delivery charge will be removed
The deposit will automatically be refunded
qs.ex: «Further reductions cannot lower the invoice» — если обедов нужно меньше, сумма не уменьшится.

qs.stem: What must the organizer arrange for an upstairs event?
opts: Helpers to move food from the entrance
Return of all disposable cutlery
Payment fifteen minutes before arrival
A driver who supplies extra napkins upstairs
qs.ex: «The delivery charge covers bringing the food to the building entrance, not carrying it upstairs. Please arrange helpers…»

doc.head: COMPOST COLLECTION PILOT
paras: For the next eight weeks, registered homes may put food scraps in the new brown containers. Meat, bones, and cooked food are accepted; packaging is not, even when labeled biodegradable. Liners supplied with the container are permitted because the treatment facility has tested them. Please do not buy substitutes without checking with the pilot team. Containers will be emptied on Fridays, separately from normal rubbish collection. A missed collection should be reported by noon Monday, but residents should leave the container out only if the team confirms a return visit. You may leave without affecting standard waste services; we will collect the loaned container. Afterward, contamination rates and household feedback will inform decisions about wider provision. Registration alone does not guarantee permanent provision.
Close the lid securely to discourage animals.

qs.stem: Which item is permitted in the brown container?
opts: The packaging around cooked food
Any shop-bought compost liner
Any biodegradable food packaging
A liner supplied by the pilot team
qs.ex: «Liners supplied with the container are permitted… Please do not buy substitutes without checking». Упаковка запрещена, даже biodegradable.

qs.stem: What should residents do after reporting a missed pickup?
opts: Stop all standard rubbish collections
Add packaging so the team notices it
Keep it outside until the eight-week trial ends
Leave the container out only if a return visit is confirmed
qs.ex: «…leave the container out only if the team confirms a return visit».

qs.stem: What is uncertain about the service?
opts: Whether participants may withdraw
Whether the container is on loan
Whether it will continue after the trial
Whether meat scraps are accepted
qs.ex: «Registration alone does not guarantee permanent provision» — неизвестно, продолжится ли сервис после пилота. Выйти из пилота можно, мясо принимается.

msgs.text: 10: I'm working that Saturday now. Could you take my furniture-painting workshop place?
14: I'd like to. Does the organizer allow transfers?
17: Yes, up to Thursday noon. I need to email your name. The booking includes materials for a small wooden item, which you bring yourself.
21: I have a metal chair. Would that work?
25: The email specifically says wood. A wooden shelf could work. It must fit on a table; transport isn't provided.
29: I'll check what I have this evening before committing.
32: Please let me know by ten tomorrow morning. If you can't go, I'll offer it to my cousin so I can still meet the transfer deadline.
34: I'll measure my shelf tonight.

qs.stem: Which item meets the workshop requirements?
opts: A wooden item supplied by the organizer
A large wooden wardrobe needing transport help
A small wooden shelf that fits on a table
A metal chair that fits on a table
qs.ex: Нужна небольшая деревянная вещь, которая помещается на стол: «specifically says wood… It must fit on a table». Материалы дают, а предмет приносят свой.

qs.stem: Why does Alma set an earlier reply time than the transfer deadline?
opts: To leave time to find another person
To make Victor pay for materials twice
To arrange transport from the workshop
To avoid emailing the organizer
qs.ex: Передать место можно до четверга, полдня. Алме нужен запас, чтобы при отказе Виктора успеть предложить место кузине: «so I can still meet the transfer deadline».

qs.stem: What does "before committing" mean here?
opts: Before applying paint to the item
Before agreeing definitely to attend
Before sending furniture to a shop
Before starting a new job
qs.ex: Commit — твёрдо пообещать. Before committing — прежде чем окончательно согласиться пойти.

doc.head: HARBOR HISTORY ROOM DIGITAL IMAGE REQUESTS
paras: Visitors may request digital copies of photographs in our local archive. The online catalogue shows low-resolution previews, which are suitable for finding an image but not for printing it clearly. Staff can supply a high-resolution file within five working days if the original has been digitized. Undigitized photographs require a separate assessment and may take longer. A copying fee does not purchase publication rights. Images used in public displays or commercial projects may need permission from the copyright holder; staff can share available ownership information but cannot grant rights they do not hold. Please identify the catalogue number in your request, rather than attaching a screenshot alone. Requests sent after Wednesday may not be ready for a weekend event.
File delivery is by a secure download link.

qs.stem: What should a digital-copy request include?
opts: The image's catalogue number
Proof that the image is already published
Only a screenshot of the preview
A weekend-event ticket
qs.ex: «Please identify the catalogue number in your request, rather than attaching a screenshot alone».

qs.stem: What does paying the copying fee establish?
opts: Permission for every commercial use
A guarantee of delivery before the weekend
Ownership of the original photograph
Payment for a copy, without automatically securing publication rights
qs.ex: «A copying fee does not purchase publication rights» — оплачивается только копия, права на публикацию отдельно.

qs.stem: Why does the announcement describe previews as low resolution?
opts: To promise that all originals are digitized
To require commercial permission for viewing previews
To prohibit searching the catalogue
To explain why they may not produce clear prints
qs.ex: Превью «suitable for finding an image but not for printing it clearly» — автор объясняет, почему они не годятся для чёткой печати.

doc.head: MARKET LANE - OUTDOOR TABLES
paras: Cafés may place tables outside from May 1 under the revised pavement permit. A clear pedestrian passage of at least two meters must be maintained, measured from occupied chairs, not empty tables. Planters and menu boards count as obstructions too. Permits authorize seating until 8 p.m.; they do not extend a café's existing alcohol license. Furniture must be removed overnight unless a separate storage arrangement has been approved. Inspectors will first advise businesses about minor layout problems, but a serious access obstruction may require immediate removal of tables. Existing permit holders must submit a new layout sketch by April 20. Renewals will be reviewed against these standards rather than approved automatically.
Keep the approved sketch available for inspectors.

qs.stem: How is the required pedestrian passage measured?
opts: From occupied chairs rather than empty tables
Only after all customers have left
Without counting planters or menu boards
With every chair pushed under its table
qs.ex: «…measured from occupied chairs, not empty tables».

qs.stem: What does having an existing pavement permit mean?
opts: Overnight furniture storage is always allowed
Renewal is automatic without a sketch
Alcohol service is extended until 8 p.m.
A revised layout still needs review for renewal
qs.ex: «Renewals will be reviewed against these standards rather than approved automatically» — нужен новый план расстановки, и его проверят.

qs.stem: What may happen when a layout seriously blocks access?
opts: The existing permit guarantees another review before removal
Tables may need to be removed immediately
The business receives advice but may keep the tables in place
Inspectors must wait until the next renewal
qs.ex: «…a serious access obstruction may require immediate removal of tables». Предупреждения сначала — только для мелких нарушений.

doc.subject: Delivery changes from November
paras: Dear reader,

From November, our magazine will arrive monthly rather than twice a month. Each issue will contain more pages, and your prepaid subscription will be extended so you still receive the number of issues purchased. Digital access is unchanged. If you prefer to cancel, request a refund for undelivered issues by October 25. After that date, cancellation remains possible, but refunds will be calculated under our standard policy rather than this special arrangement. You need not reply to keep receiving the print edition. Subscribers who recently changed address should update their account before October 20; replying to this email with an address will not update delivery records. We are combining issues to reduce distribution costs, not removing the local reporting section.
Valley Review
Account passwords and sign-in procedures remain unchanged.

qs.stem: What will happen to a prepaid subscription kept active?
opts: It will last longer to supply the purchased number of issues
It will automatically lose digital access
It will require a reply to remain active
It will provide half the purchased issues
qs.ex: «…your prepaid subscription will be extended so you still receive the number of issues purchased». Цифровой доступ не меняется.

qs.stem: How should a subscriber change their delivery address?
opts: Update their account before October 20
Wait until the first monthly issue arrives
Request an events-guide correction
Reply with the address to this email
qs.ex: «…update their account before October 20; replying to this email with an address will not update delivery records».

qs.stem: Why does the email mention the local reporting section?
opts: To reassure readers that this content will remain
To announce a separate subscription fee for local news
To explain which section is being discontinued
To replace all printed content with digital reports
qs.ex: «…not removing the local reporting section» — успокоить читателей: этот раздел останется.

doc.head: WEST LINE - WEEKEND WORKS · Saturday and Sunday, September 21-22
doc.foot:
Replacement shuttles leave from the coach stop outside Town Station, not the usual forecourt bus stop. Rail tickets are valid on the shuttles. The printed connections include a ten-minute transfer, but onward trains will not be held if road traffic delays a shuttle. Passengers attending time-sensitive events should consider an earlier departure. Standard bicycles cannot be carried; folded bicycles are accepted if kept inside a bag. Accessible spaces must be reserved through the rail assistance team by Friday noon. This reservation secures an accessible shuttle space, not an onward train seat. Normal rail service is expected to resume Monday, subject to safety checks.
Shuttle drivers can indicate the designated luggage area.

qs.stem: Where do the replacement shuttles depart?
opts: The coach stop outside Town Station
The rail assistance office
The onward train platform
The usual forecourt bus stop
qs.ex: «Replacement shuttles leave from the coach stop outside Town Station, not the usual forecourt bus stop».

qs.stem: What is the risk for a passenger on the 10:00 shuttle?
opts: The train always waits for the shuttle
Road delays could cause a missed onward connection
The planned transfer takes thirty-five minutes
A rail ticket will not cover the shuttle
qs.ex: На пересадку 10 минут, и «onward trains will not be held if road traffic delays a shuttle». Пробка может сорвать пересадку.

qs.stem: What does an assistance reservation guarantee?
opts: Monday service regardless of safety checks
Carriage of an unfolded standard bicycle
An accessible space on the shuttle
A seat on the onward train
qs.ex: «This reservation secures an accessible shuttle space, not an onward train seat».

doc.head: LARK STUDIO - FAMILY PORTRAITS
paras: Our $95 package includes a forty-minute session and five edited digital images; extras cost $12 each. The booking deposit of $30 is part of the package price, not an extra fee. Bookings can be made at the front desk.
A booking can sometimes be extended.
Bookings can be made a week ahead.
qs.ex: Бронирование возможно «online only», у стойки нельзя. Остальные утверждения есть в форме.

doc.head: Writing Center Workshops · Fall Semester
doc.foot: Each workshop lasts 50 minutes. Seats are limited to 20, so register online at least a day before. Students who attend three workshops receive a certificate that some instructors accept as extra credit.

qs.stem: Where will the workshop on editing take place?
opts: Room 105
The Writing Center office
Online
Room 220
qs.ex: В расписании: «Room 220 (moved from Room 105)» — аудитория изменена на 220.

qs.stem: Why should students register at least a day before a workshop?
opts: Only twenty seats are available.
The rooms are changed every day.
The workshops are canceled without registration.
Instructors must approve each student.
qs.ex: Seats are limited to 20 — мест 20, поэтому нужна регистрация заранее.

qs.stem: What can be inferred about the certificate?
opts: Every instructor gives extra credit for it.
It is required to graduate.
Its value depends on the instructor.
It is given after one workshop.
qs.ex: «Some instructors accept» — только некоторые преподаватели засчитывают сертификат, значит, польза зависит от конкретного преподавателя.

doc.head: EXAM ACCOMMODATION REQUEST
rows: Letter from the Student Support Office, attached
doc.foot: Requests must be submitted at least ten working days before the exam. Late requests will be considered only in emergencies, and approval cannot be guaranteed. Instructors are told about the accommodation but not about the reason for it. Approved students must bring a copy of the confirmation email to the exam.

qs.stem: When must a request be submitted?
opts: On the day of the exam
At least ten working days before the exam
After the instructor approves it
Within ten days after the exam
qs.ex: Первое предложение примечания: не позже чем за десять рабочих дней до экзамена.

qs.stem: What is suggested about late requests?
opts: They are usually approved quickly.
They are never read by the office.
They must be sent to the instructor.
They might be refused even in an emergency.
qs.ex: Позднюю заявку рассматривают только в экстренных случаях, и одобрение не гарантировано, то есть отказ возможен даже тогда.

qs.stem: The word "guaranteed" in the form is closest in meaning to
opts: promised for certain
carefully checked
quickly delivered
paid in advance
qs.ex: Approval cannot be guaranteed — одобрение нельзя обещать наверняка. Guaranteed = promised for certain.

doc.head: Campus Parking Permits
doc.foot: Permits can be bought online or at the Security Office. Parking is free after 6 p.m.

qs.stem: How much does a student save by buying one all-year permit instead of two semester permits?
qs.ex: Два семестровых пропуска: 2 × $70 = $140. Годовой стоит $120, экономия $20.

qs.stem: Where can a permit be bought?
opts: Only online
Online or at the Security Office
Only at the Security Office
At any parking space
qs.ex: «Online or at the Security Office» — оба способа допустимы.
